summary: Honor explicit TestQL target and validate dry runs without runtime assertions

delivery.outcome: Honor explicit CLI base_url throughout scenario assignments and report dry-run syntax validation separately from execution.
nonGoals: No physical actuator commands or firmware deployment
No forced rewriting of absolute URLs for other explicitly named services
No node configuration or protected policy changes

architecture.decision: Pin the CLI base_url override in the interpreter; validate response assertion syntax in dry-run and expose separate validated/executed metrics while retaining legacy step status compatibility. Ordinary interpreter-variable assertions remain evaluated during dry-run; only response-dependent assertions are skipped.
interfaceChanges: Optional interpreter base_url_override argument; explicit CLI target has precedence over CONFIG/SET.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-030 source commit; keep hardware settings and installed runtime unchanged until qualified publication.

validation.evidence: Two real local servers and INCLUDE regression prove only the CLI target is contacted.
No HTTP execution, zero executed steps, malformed syntax rejected and live assertion failures preserved.
99 focused regressions and managed governance pass; protected exact-head review remains required.
Reproduce advisory: available variable mismatches must fail in dry-run; response data remains syntax-only.
